questions.stem: When two heterozygous parents (Bb x Bb) are crossed, what is the expected ratio of phenotypes in the offspring?
questions.explanation: When two heterozygous parents (Bb x Bb) are crossed, the expected phenotype ratio is 3 dominant : 1 recessive. Three out of four offspring will show the dominant phenotype (BB or Bb) and one will show the recessive phenotype (bb).
